title: Camera-Tracking Gimbal
summary: I am designing a servo-driven gimbal that tracks objects using the on-sensor detection built into the Sony IMX500 AI camera.
result: Servo-driven tracking gimbal using pretrained on-sensor detection, with servos sized at under 15% of rated torque.
spec: Only the camera sits on the moving stage, and the base mounts to the desk, which keeps the MG90S servos under 15% of their rated torque.
Routing the CSI ribbon cable through the rotation axes is the primary CAD and integration risk.
Raspberry Pi 5, Sony IMX500 AI Camera, Picamera2, MG90S servos, SolidWorks
